page.overview:
Who is Lon Bennor?

Lon Bennor was a male who lived in the city of Domaz on the planet Kolatill, located within the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. In 8 ABY, Domaz was assaulted by TIE bombers from the Imperial Ton-Falk-class escort carrier Kathol Protector. The attack was in retaliation for the population of Kolatill overthrowing their Imperial governor in the wake of the New Republic's liberation of the nearby planet of Kal'Shebbol. With the city devastated, Bennor began to organize relief efforts from a park that had been converted into an emergency aid station. He accepted help from the crew of the New Republic vessel FarStar—who had responded to a distress call from the planet—in providing medical assistance and enlisted their services to retrieve more supplies from a bombed-out hospital.

Lon Bennor was a male who resided on the planet Kolatill in the Kathol sector in the Outer Rim Territories, and lived in the capital city of Domaz. the New Republic liberated the planet of Kal'Shebbol, the sector capital. As a result, the local Imperial Moff, Kentor Sarne—who had set himself up as a warlord following the death of Emperor Palpatine at the Battle of Endor four years previously—was forced to flee his capital with the majority of his forces. When news of the New Republic's victory at Kal'Shebbol reached the population of Kolatill, they staged a popular uprising, overthrowing and imprisoning their Imperial governor, Tetrum, and reinstating the Kolatill Council to lead them.

Shortly after this act of rebellion, the Imperial Ton-Falk-class escort carrier Kathol Protector arrived in-system and used TIE bombers to assault Domaz. Bennor survived the devastation wrought on his home and immediately began to organize relief efforts from a park at the heart of the city that had been converted into an emergency aid station. He blamed the Kolatill Council for the attack, since they had publicly declared allegiance to the New Republic after being reinstated into power.

Four days after the attack, the crew of the New Republic CR90 corvette FarStar arrived to assist in relief operations. Bennor was not particularly pleased to see them, as they were representatives of the government that had indirectly been the cause of the attack on Domaz. However, he did accept their assistance and medical supplies, since his priorities were saving as many lives as possible. Bennor also requested the assistance of FarStar crew members when he went to a bombed-out hospital to retrieve much needed medical supplies. With their help, he was able to overcome collapsing floors, fires, and other hazards to recover the supplies.
